subject: Private viewing: one lot, one evening
body: {sender} writes: "Before the auction house gets it, a small circle sees it first. A European canvas, impeccable provenance — and the circle notices who bids and who only looks."

choices.label: Bid seriously (−{money_fmt:2500})

effects.text: The canvas over the fireplace cost a fortune — and pays it back every time a guest falls silent in front of it.

choices.outcome: The hammer falls in your favor. The room applauds politely — and reassesses you on the spot.

choices.label: Attend, admire, abstain (1⏱)
choices.outcome: You study the brushwork and the bidders in equal measure. Both are instructive.

choices.label: Decline
choices.outcome: Art is patient. Your bank account thanks you — the circle forgets you a little.

subject: A letter you almost didn't recognize
body: The handwriting is from the old days, before the office on Sunset. {sender} is short — properly short — and asks for a loan. "You know I'm good for it. You knew me when nobody was."

choices.label: Send the money, no questions (−{money_fmt:800})

effects.label: A loan for an old friend

effects.text: The loan comes back months later — with interest of the useful kind: a friend at a print desk.

else.text: The money is gone the way loans among old friends go. You knew that when you sent it.

choices.outcome: Some debts run in the other direction: this town gave you everything, and someone carried you once. The check goes out the same day.

choices.label: Decline — softly, but decline
choices.outcome: You write three drafts of the letter. All three say no. The last one at least says it kindly.

subject: An invoice without a letterhead
body: No sender, no greeting: "A photograph exists. Taken at a party you attended. Nothing scandalous — unless someone writes the caption. The negative costs {money_fmt:1500}. Private funds, of course."

choices.label: Pay from your own pocket (−{money_fmt:1500})
choices.outcome: An envelope changes hands in a parking lot. The photograph was harmless — but now nobody will ever prove otherwise.

choices.label: Call the bluff

effects.text: Weeks pass. Nothing appears anywhere. It was a fishing expedition — and you didn't bite.

effects_fail.text: The photograph runs in a gossip sheet with exactly the caption you feared. Harmless — and embarrassing.

choices.outcome: Blackmailers hate nothing more than silence. Yours was the right kind.
choices.outcome_fail: The caption writes itself — and someone else cashes in on it.
